about: The three published sample outputs of the Praxis Policy Engine ocsf-audit sink, which AID-EMIT-1 section 12 names as its conformance vectors, copied unchanged. gen_vectors.py checks these digests before reading them. The two records of SAMPLE-OUTPUT.md are signed with the published demo key, the P-256 scalar of 32 bytes 0x42 (examples/emit_sample.rs).
